_comment: PRIOR ART: none — the write-time classifier (src/lib/analytics-ingest.ts) drops crawlers by user agent but has no
rule for fleets that send browser user agents; this file is the rule for books.human_read_count (#5048).
since: the first event with a stored user_agent and traffic_class (#3405). Earlier events cannot be classified.
window_ms: a reading visit counts once, at its SECOND human read event (book_read or page_read) for the same
book from the same /24 within this window. Pools that rotate one request per address count at 0.1-0.4% of
their events; Firefox and other browsers at 4.7-13.6%.
max_books_per_ip_day: a /24 that sends read events for this many distinct books or more in one UTC day is a
crawler for that day (one walked 618 books on 2026-07-30..08-03). 3,990 of 1.07M ip-days, 468K events.
pool_user_agents: fleets that hold a few addresses and walk many pages: Lightpanda (207K events Aug-Sep, #4543)
and a Windows UA rotation over Chrome 103-124 (~3.5K events per version per fortnight, evenly spread).
